the key contributors, they made 80 and 62 respectively and put on a 121-run stand off 
128 balls, which rose through the gears gradually. They came in after Bumrah 
outclassed Zadran to have him caught behind and Gurbaz being bounced out by 
Pandya. The first two ten-over blocks went for 48 for 1 and 35 for 2 but their calculated 
risks, especially from Omarzai against Kuldeep, helped them tick and put up 64 in the 
third and fourth ten-over blocks. Siraj had an off day for India. Hardik got two key 
wickets and controlled his lengths decently. Kuldeep's good form continued. Jadeja's 
quick, economical bowling probably saved India from being forced to have an extra 
fielder in the ring for an extra over or two. Nabi couldn't get going for Afghanistan and

something to defend.
